principle: All scientific choices are fixed before implementation and before any scientific A2b run. Implementation choices may be delegated only when they preserve the normative SPEC semantics and canonical output contract.

choices.freeze: SPEC_PRIMITIVO_N2_A_REPLICA_CERRADA_v0_1.md sections 1-12 are authoritative; no alternate interpretation may change values without INVALID status.
CPython 3.12 standard library only; source organization may vary, but the sealed execution interface and canonical outputs may not.

Use exact integer/rational arithmetic where the SPEC defines exact values. Compute information measures with IEEE-754 binary64 and serialize finite real values rounded to six decimal places using a decimal point.

Record every encountered ambiguity before its result is used. A value-affecting ambiguity without a unique SPEC resolution stops the run as INVALID; formal-only choices use the deterministic convention stated in the ambiguity record.
Exactly one scientific invocation of the fixed command. A nonzero exit, incomplete manifest, or output-schema failure is INVALID; no repair-and-rerun is allowed under the same run identifier.
No comparison occurs in the blind workspace. The investigator applies SPEC section 14 only after raw results are sealed.
